message.content:
This is a cellular gateway with Bluetooth that is designed for and used solely with Philips Respironics ventilators. The question is whether it classifies as a part or accessory of the ventilators (9019.20) or as a transmission apparatus (8517.62).

Heading 9019 covers respiratory apparatus, including ventilators. Under Section XVI Note 2 and Chapter 90 Note 2, parts and accessories that are suitable for use solely or principally with a particular machine are classified with that machine. However, Chapter 90 Note 1(m)/Section XVI Note... excludes articles of Chapter 85 only where they are not covered by the rule. A device that performs a communication function is a machine of heading 8517 in its own right, and Note 3 to Section XVI plus the Chapter 90 notes would send it to 8517.62. CBP rulings on similar cellular gateways and hubs for medical devices have typically classified them under 8517.62.0090, as machines for the reception, conversion, and transmission of data.

The closest option is 8517.62.0090. The "Other" subheading 8517.62.00 now covers machines for reception, conversion, and transmission or regeneration of voice, images, or other data, and the statistical suffix is 90.

```json
{"hts_code": "8517.62.0090", "reason": "The cellular/Bluetooth communications gateway is a data transmission and reception apparatus of heading 8517, so it is classified there as an other apparatus for transmission or reception of data rather than as a ventilator accessory of 9019."}
```
